title: 第25章 晋升大宗师狠辣的郡主第26章 动我镇北王府的世子谁给你的勇气
slug: 我纨绔世子开局征服太子妃
content_zh:
镇北王府！
楚风刚迈入府中，管家福伯便迎了上来。
“世子，王爷听说您需要修炼资源，连夜又调集了一批，已经送到你房间了。”
“真的？”
楚风神色一喜，直接说道：“太好了！
替我感谢一下爷爷！”
回到房间，看着那堆积如山的修炼资源，楚风没有丝毫耽搁，当即盘膝坐下，开始了闭关。
而他这一闭关，便是三天。
这三天内，京城街头巷尾，都在议论一件事，那便是——
镇北世子与萧大将军的婚事！
一个是手握重兵的第一异姓王府。
一个是位列四公之首，门生故吏遍布朝野的顶级世家。
两大军权巨擘的联姻，其背后蕴含的意义，足以让大乾的权力格局重新洗牌。
一时间，无论是朝堂还是江湖，无数双眼睛都盯着这场婚礼，空气中弥漫着一股风雨欲来的压抑气息。
而在婚礼的前一日，
楚风的房间内。
轰！
伴随着一声沉闷的巨响，一股磅礴浩瀚的气息如火山喷发般轰然炸开，房间内的桌椅摆设瞬间被恐怖的劲气碾为齑粉。
这股气浪甚至穿透了墙壁，朝着院中汹涌而去。
守在门外的冷月，只觉一股无可匹敌的大力袭来，被震得接连倒退数步，脚下青石板寸寸龟裂，她那张清冷的脸上，第一次露出了骇然之色。

房间内。
楚风盘坐在床榻的废墟之上，双眸蓦然睁开，两道骇人的精光一闪而逝。
他周身气机流转，一股远超从前的恐怖威势弥漫开来。
大宗师！
闭关三日，他直接跨过了无数武者一生都难以逾越的天堑，从先天境，一跃突破宗师，并且最终踏入了大宗师之境！
“这就是大宗师的力量么……”
楚风缓缓握拳，感受着体内奔腾如江海般的真气，心中激荡不已。
从一个手无缚鸡之力的普通人，到如今的大宗师，他只用了不到一个星期。
这等修炼速度若是传出去，足以让整个大乾为之震动！
当然，这还是因为葬天棺这个“饕餮巨兽”
吞噬了大部分能量，楚风自己只得到了炼化出的三分之一，否则，他甚至有信心一窥那传说中的指玄之境。
“小弟弟，不错嘛，不过这才刚刚开始哦。”
妖姬娇媚的声音在脑海中响起，比之前凝实了许多，显然因为葬天棺吸收了不少能量，也让她获益匪浅。
“咦？什么味儿？”
楚风忽然耸了耸鼻子，闻到一股难以言喻的恶臭。
content_en:
Zhenbei Palace!
As soon as Chu Feng entered the mansion, Butler Fu Bo came to greet him.
"Your Majesty, I heard that you need cultivation resources, so I gathered another batch overnight and have sent them to your room."
"Really?"
Chu Feng looked happy and said directly: "Great!
Thank you grandpa for me! "
Returning to the room, Chu Feng looked at the mountains of cultivation resources. Without any delay, Chu Feng immediately sat down cross-legged and began to retreat.
And his retreat lasted for three days.
In the past three days, one thing has been discussed in the streets and lanes of the capital, and that is——
The marriage between Prince Zhenbei and General Xiao!
One is the No. 1 prince with a different surname who has a lot of troops.
One is a top aristocratic family that ranks first among the four princes and has disciples and former officials throughout the government and the public.
The significance behind the marriage of the two military giants is enough to reshuffle the power structure of Daqian.
For a time, no matter in the court or in the arena, countless pairs of eyes were fixed on the wedding, and the air was filled with a depressing atmosphere of approaching storm.
And the day before the wedding,
In Chu Feng's room.
boom!
Along with a dull loud noise, a majestic and vast aura exploded like a volcanic eruption, and the tables and chairs in the room were instantly crushed into powder by the terrifying force.
This wave of air even penetrated the wall and surged towards the courtyard.
Leng Yue, who was guarding the door, felt an unparalleled force coming towards her. She was shaken and took several steps backwards. The bluestone beneath her feet was cracked. For the first time, her cold face showed a look of horror.
inside the room.
Chu Feng sat cross-legged on the ruins of the bed, his eyes suddenly opened, and two terrifying lights flashed away.
Qi circulated around him, and a terrifying power far beyond what he had before permeated the air.
Great master!
After three days of seclusion, he directly crossed the natural chasm that countless warriors would find difficult to overcome in their lifetimes, jumped from the innate realm to the master realm, and finally stepped into the grand master realm!
"Is this the power of the Grand Master..."
Chu Feng slowly clenched his fist, feeling the infuriating energy flowing in his body like a river and sea, and his heart was filled with excitement.
It only took him less than a week to go from an ordinary person with no strength to the great master he is today.
If this speed of cultivation were to spread, it would be enough to shake the entire Daqian!
Of course, this is because of the "taotie giant beast" called the Sky Burial Coffin.
After devouring most of the energy, Chu Feng himself only got one-third of the refined energy. Otherwise, he would even have the confidence to have a glimpse of the legendary Zhixuan realm.
"Little brother, it's not bad, but this is just the beginning."
The charming voice of the enchantress sounded in her mind, much more solid than before. It was obvious that the Sky Burial Coffin absorbed a lot of energy, which also benefited her a lot.
"Huh? What does it smell like?"
Chu Feng suddenly shrugged his nose and smelled an indescribable stench.
